title: Supplementary File S1: Code, data and results for "Integrating Structured Mammography Report Descriptors with Image-Derived Features for Breast Cancer Diagnosis"
description: Code, public de-identified datasets, raw outputs and figures that reproduce every number, table and figure in the manuscript "Integrating Structured Mammography Report Descriptors with Image-Derived Features for Breast Cancer Diagnosis". Datasets: UCI Mammographic Mass (Elter et al. 2007), Woods et al. (1993) mammography microcalcification features, and Wisconsin Diagnostic Breast Cancer (Street et al. 1993).
